name: save-the-hero-factory
description: A cartoon choose-your-rescue video factory for TikTok, powered by Remotion.

scripts.render:demo: npm run audio:generate && remotion render src/index.ts SaveTheHeroDemo output/episode-001.mp4 --public-dir=assets --codec=h264
scripts.render:preview: npm run audio:generate && remotion render src/index.ts SaveTheHeroDemo output/episode-001-preview.mp4 --public-dir=assets --codec=h264 --scale=0.5 --concurrency=1
scripts.still: npm run audio:generate && remotion still src/index.ts SaveTheHeroDemo output/preview.png --frame=180 --public-dir=assets
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run test && npm run typecheck
